description: The orders of one protocol past their expected next stage, each with one named reason from the protocol stage register: a LayerZero message verified but not committed or committed but not executed, an Across deposit not filled, an ERC-8183 job submitted but not evaluated. Returns: { protocol, generated_at, tracked, lag, reasons[], counts, stuck[]: { key, reason, stage, age_s, expected, src_chain, dst_chain, stages } }, oldest first; 404 for a protocol not watched (with why). (GET /v1/protocol/:protocol/stuck)

api_key.description: your tfr_ key (optional for keyless reads)

reason.description: one of the protocol’s reasons (see reasons[])

name: coord_protocol_stuck
